verdict.rationale: 2FAS is a local-first 2FA authenticator and password manager with no automation or workflow engine; its llms.txt states 'Public API: None'. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a category error for this product type, not a missing feature. Source-code review on GitHub and vault backup or recovery are unrelated to user automations and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
